weather_report:
As the clock ticks towards the early morning hours, Downtown San Francisco drapes itself in a shroud of clouds, holding a crisp, fragrant breath of coastal air. The temperature dances around a pleasant 56 degrees, with whispers of a gentle west-southwest breeze barely rustling the leaves. The sky, though mostly cloudy, hints at a transformation awaiting the sun’s awakening. 

Come Friday, the clouds will part just enough to unveil fleeting sunbeams, promising a high of 73 degrees that will gradually retreat to a comfortable 70 in the afternoon. The day will unfurl with a soft, inviting warmth, yet the presence of fog along the coast reminds us of the region's complex maritime personality. A light jacket or sweater should be a companion for morning and evening excursions, while layers will keep comfort at bay as one ventures into the sun’s embrace. The atmospheric conditions beckon for a leisurely stroll along the Embarcadero, sipping artisanal coffee, or perhaps exploring the local shops, as the vibrant heartbeat of the city slowly emerges from the morning lull.
